text:
Lena: Anyone else seeing 502s from edge-us-west inference-proxy? noticed spike at ~09:03
Sam: yep dashboards show 502+5020ms latencies on proxy -> model pool
Miguel: digging in ALB, health checks failing for a subset of targets
Lena: pods show readiness probe flapping (connection refused) but liveness OK
Aya: looks like networking — VPC Flow logs show DENY entries to high ports from the ALB back to targets
Sam: I merged a policy change earlier this morning to tighten ephemeral port usage (security request). Could have clipped something
Miguel: pasting one flow log line below
```
2026-03-18T08:58:15Z eni-0abc 54.210.11.22 10.0.5.23 443 49152 TCP DENY
```
Lena: ALB health -> target uses ephemeral src port 49152. NACL denying 49152-65535?
Aya: confirmed — there was a DENY rule added to the edge-us-west NACL to block high ephemeral range (adjacent PR: tighten-edge-nacl). It was intended to block inbound ephemeral from untrusted ASGs but we accidentally applied both directions
Sam: argh my bad, I scoped the rule wrong. I thought it was inbound-only. :grimacing:
Miguel: quick mitigation options: 1) add explicit ALLOW for 49152-65535 in NACL, 2) change ALB health check to a fixed source port (not ideal), 3) revert the NACL change
Lena: we need fast fix — add temporary allow on NACL so healthchecks recover, then revert to a safer rule in a follow-up with proper tests
Sam: applying NACL allow now (doing via console since it's urgent)
ops-bot: change-request: infra/edge-us-west-allow-ephemeral created by Sam - awaiting propagation
Sam: applied and propagated, ALB reports healthy for previously failing targets within 45s
Lena: pods stopped flapping, traffic back to normal :thumbsup:
Miguel: creating follow-up ticket to update ci checks — we need e2e that exercises ALB->target ephemeral mapping on every NACL change
Aya: also add a one-line runbook: "When tightening NACLs, ensure ephemeral outbound ranges to ALBs are allowed or use ALB fixed health port mapping"
Sam: will open PR to revert the overbroad DENY and add unit/infra test. Sorry for the outage everyone
Lena: no worries, thanks for the quick rollback. can we also add a label to the change PR to force security review next time?
Miguel: yep, adding network-owner review requirement to PR template for edge NACLs
deploy-bot: incident logged: INC-2026-03-edge-ingress-ephemeral-01 (link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2026-03-edge-ingress-ephemeral-01)
Aya: assigned to @sam + @miguel for follow-up, I'll write the runbook entry now
Lena: closing thread for now. file follow-up in infra backlog. thanks all.
